evaluation_scope: all 12,000 labeled source rows; diagnostic only, not an independent holdout
execution_note: Aggregates were calculated with a local Node.js parity harness that mirrors the deterministic rules in src/llm_client.py. Python/FastAPI were unavailable, so the Python evaluator and API were not run.
privacy_note: The source CSV and ticket free text are not included in this ZIP. No ticket-level content was printed by the evaluation harness.
limitations: These are rule-baseline diagnostics, not LLM performance metrics.
The full source rows were used, not a holdout; this is not a production generalization estimate.
API response validation, latency, Docker, and model/token costs were not measured.
